title: fyniq-scenario@1
description: A differential-test scenario that the Go engine (cmd/scenario-run) and the Python oracle (oracle/) both read (QA-ENG-02, task 2.1). The schema fixes the structure; the content of journal lines and P1 documents (amounts, rates, currency codes, accounts, balance) is checked by the posting rules, which reject the document rather than the scenario. README.md beside this file states the rules a schema cannot express. Patterns are RE2- and ECMA-262-compatible so validators in both languages agree.

name.description: A short, file-safe name: the generator writes the scenario to <name>.json.

base_currency.description: The organisation's base currency; must be a key of currencies.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 code -> minor units (SGD 2, JPY 0, KWD 3). Amounts are NUMERIC(20,4), so at most 4.

accounts.description: The chart of accounts. Codes are unique.

group.description: A group (parent) account cannot be posted to (INV-04).

role.description: Optional. "share-capital" marks an account a manual journal may not post to (INV-13, PRD-001 rev 0.24), such as 3010 and 3020 in the default chart.

as_of.description: The organisation's business date, 'today' (ENG-05): scheduled entries (releases) dated on or before it post. Required, and on or after every date in the scenario, when a document is not a manual journal.

documents.description: Posted in array order. IDs are unique.

reversals.description: Applied in array order, after every document.

document.description: The ID of the manual journal whose posted entry is reversed.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; an impossible day (2026-02-30) makes the scenario invalid.

documentId.description: Unique in the scenario. No '/', which the result uses for '<id>/reversal'.

version.description: Read but not used: every document posts its version 1.

money.description: A decimal string, checked by the posting rules (ENG-44): a bad one rejects its document.

rate.description: Base per unit of the amount's currency (ENG-11). Only for amounts not in the base currency, and always with fx_rate_source.

rateSource.description: Where the rate came from (ENG-40), e.g. "document". Only with fx_rate.

document.description: One document; its type picks its shape.

settings.description: The organisation's settings the P1 rule sets read (README, Settings).

books_start.description: The first day of the books (FR-FA-02).

accounts.description: System accounts by key (Appendix B.5). Each must be in accounts.

money_accounts.description: Bank, card, wallet and cash accounts (FR-BNK-01) -> the currency each holds.

tolerance.description: Settlement tolerances (FR-BNK-08, open question 32), in the base currency and percent; each defaults to the PRD's.

gst.description: GST registration (from, to inclusive) and the standard rate from each date (the sg-gst pack, ENG-31).

per_line.description: RND-GST-EXCL per line instead of per subtotal.

billLine.description: A bill's or vendor credit's line: a net amount, or quantity × unit price (RND-LINE), its GST code and the GST its tax invoice states.

amount.description: The net, in the bill's currency.

quantity_before.description: What earlier bills took of a purchase order's line (RND-LINE, rev 0.87).

gst.description: The GST the tax invoice states, in the bill's currency; 0 when absent.

gst_base.description: A foreign bill's line: the GST its tax invoice states in the base currency (ENG-42).

business_share.description: The percent of the GST claimable (FR-AP-20, RND-GST-SHARE); 100 when absent.

spread_from.description: The day its service starts; its month is the first release's. The bill's when absent.

bill.description: A bill (bill@1) or a vendor credit (vendor_credit@1, the bill's legs negated).

withholding.description: Tax withheld from a non-resident supplier (FR-AP-19, RND-WHT): the tax agent's rate.

settlement.description: Money that settles posted documents (bill_payment@1, ...): its parts, and what it keeps unapplied.

account.description: The money account, in the documents' currency or the base currency.

base_amount.description: What a base-currency account paid or received for documents in another currency.

unapplied.description: What it paid beyond the parts, kept as a credit (FR-AR-18).

amount.description: What it pays of the document, in its currency.

in_full.description: Settle all that is open though it pays less, within tolerance (rev 0.121).

bankTransaction.description: A bank, card or cash line categorised into parts (bank_transaction@1, Appendix B.1).

amount.description: Signed gross: money in positive, money out negative.
Signed as the line, in its currency; the parts add up to the line.

fee.description: A fee the provider reports, in the paying currency, part of what was paid.

lines.description: Any number of lines: fewer than two is a rejection, not a scenario error.

journalLine.description: Every value is a string, so no parser reads it as a binary float. Whether the account exists, the currency is known, the amount is a plain decimal at most at the currency's minor units and within 16 integer digits, and the rate is a plain positive decimal with at most 10 decimals, is a posting rule: a line that breaks one is rejected with its document. A rate without its source is malformed input instead: the scenario is invalid (PRD-001 rev 0.24).

fx_rate.description: Base per unit of the line's currency. Only on lines not in the base currency, and always with fx_rate_source.

fx_rate_source.description: Where the rate came from (ENG-40), e.g. "document". Only with fx_rate.
